title: How does explain check an artifact?

scenes.narration: The prompt `/explain` takes a subject. It makes an artifact that must pass four checks before handoff.

cites.snippet: the four checks an explain artifact must pass before handoff

scenes.narration: It prints one line for each check, in order. First comes self-contained, then render, citations and prose.

cites.snippet: stdout carries one line per check, in this order

scenes.narration: Every check runs, even after a failure. When all checks pass, the artifact is ready.

cites.snippet: Every check runs even after an earlier one failed.
